items.title: Golden Mask of Tutankhamun
items.description: A ceremonial funerary mask discovered in the tomb of Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings.

items.title: Bust of Nefertiti
items.description: A limestone portrait associated with the royal workshop at Amarna and the reign of Akhenaten.

items.title: Heart Scarab
items.description: A protective amulet placed with the deceased, symbolizing rebirth, protection and the journey beyond life.
